name: The PDF download refuses a name its font cannot draw and says which characters

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?scenario=near-limit (demo history read on 2026-10-19; banner data-testid=scenario-banner)
Click 'Letter' in the top navigation (data-testid=nav-letter). Do not type a URL

Fill Full name '李明' (data-testid=letter-name), Date of birth 1990-05-04 (letter-birth), Country of nationality 'Egypt' (letter-nationality), Travel document number 'A1234567' (letter-document), Email 'jane@example.com' (letter-email) and Member State 'France' (letter-member-state)
Enter 90 in the EES days used field (data-testid=letter-ees-days)
A message (data-testid=letter-error) appears that contains 'cannot draw' and '李'
